name: hilbish.messages
description:
The messages interface defines a way for Hilbish-integrated commands,
user config and other tasks to send notifications to alert the user.


A message starts out unread when it is sent with `send`. It stays
unread until it is explicitly marked with `read` (by index) or
`readAll` (every message at once). `unreadCount` and `all` reflect
this state, so a prompt or statusline can show how many messages are
waiting to be seen.


```lua
hilbish.messages.send{
	title = 'Build finished',
	text = 'go build exited with code 0',
	channel = 'build',
	icon = '✅'
}


print(hilbish.messages.unreadCount()) -- -> 1


for idx, msg in pairs(hilbish.messages.all()) do
	hilbish.messages.read(idx)
end
print(hilbish.messages.unreadCount()) -- -> 0
```

types.name: hilbish.message
description: Represents a Hilbish message.

properties.name: icon
description: Unicode (preferably standard emoji) icon for the message notification.

properties.name: title
description: Title of the message (like an email subject).

properties.name: text
description: Contents of the message.

properties.name: channel
description: Short identifier of the message. `hilbish` and `hilbish.*` is preserved for internal Hilbish messages.

properties.name: summary
description: A short summary of the message.

properties.name: index
description: Index assigned to the message once sent with `send`, used to reference it in `read` and `delete`.

properties.name: read
description: Whether the full message has been read or not.

types.name: hilbish.messageIcons
description: Predefined icons for the `icon` field of a message. Any code sending
notifications can use these, whether from user config or Hilbish itself.

properties.name: INFO
description: Icon for informational messages.

properties.name: SUCCESS
description: Icon for success messages.

properties.name: WARN
description: Icon for warning messages.

properties.name: ERROR
description: Icon for error messages.

docs.name: all
description: Returns all messages as a table keyed by their index.

returns.Name: messages
Doc: All stored messages, keyed by message index.

docs.name: clear
description: Deletes all messages.

docs.name: delete
description: Deletes the message at `idx`. Errors if the index is invalid.

params.Name: idx
Doc: Index of the message to delete.

docs.name: read
description: Marks a message at `idx` as read.

params.Name: idx
Doc: Index of the message to mark as read.

docs.name: readAll
description: Marks all messages as read.

docs.name: send
description: Sends a notification message and emits the `hilbish.notification` signal.
Do *not* emit the `hilbish.notification` signal directly.

docs.name: unreadCount
description: Returns the count of unread messages.

returns.Name: count
Doc: Number of messages that have not been marked as read.
